text_block_list.text:
I get quite a jolt at the sound of an
extremely
loud thump. I run to the
source, only to see Hishi
Amazon in the
central plaza, headbutting a tree.

Someone stopped me this morning and
asked me
if I was feeling all right, you
see...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
But man, I can't have the younger
students gettin'
worried over me. It's
pathetic!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Her fatigue is quite evident, though... I
should
probably adjust her race
schedule.
